obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]

attempts.code:
# Grasp cyan_pen, orient it upright, and place it into magenta_holder
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
table_z = obs["table_z"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_pen")
cand = next(c for c in candidates if c.get("fingers_clear", True) and c.get("hand_clear", True))
grasp(cand)

# Move high above the table to safely rotate/pitch
carry_to(hx, hy, height=0.25)

# Tilt/orient gripper so the pen (held along 'side' = approach x finger_axis) becomes vertical.
# When approach=[0, 0, -1] and fingers squeeze across pen, pen lies along side.
# To make the pen point along z (vertical), we can orient approach horizontally, e.g. approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0] -> side=[0, 0, 1].
# Check IK and move
approach = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
finger_axis = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + holder["rim_height"] + 0.12, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="joint")

# Lower pen into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.08)
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
